pages.name: Global Shell
pages.intent: Orient, search, and expose service state everywhere.
pages.desktop: Wide wordmark, restrained category navigation, persistent search/account/bag utilities.
pages.mobile: Compact masthead; labeled menu, search, and bag controls; drawers preserve focus and scroll state.
pages.imagery: No hero imagery. Use an approved monogram or subtle concrete-line device only.

visual_identity.resolution: Exactly one accent and one lockup per route; collection identity overrides global chrome only inside its route context.

390.composition: Compact masthead; labeled menu, search, and bag controls; drawers preserve focus and scroll state.
390.crop: Portrait-first art direction; no center-crop assumption.
390.density: Single column; rails are labeled inner scrollers.
390.interaction: Touch/native scroll; drawers and dialogs own focus; no hover dependency.
390.fallback: Static media/poster and linear content; no WebGL or auto-rotating sequence.

768.composition: Tablet composition derived from the desktop grammar with measured two-column regions.

768.density: Two columns only when content fits; forms remain linear.
768.interaction: Touch and keyboard parity; sticky behavior is opt-in after height/keyboard checks.
768.fallback: Poster/static equivalent for motion, video, or advanced media.

1440.composition: Wide wordmark, restrained category navigation, persistent search/account/bag utilities.
1440.crop: Expanded crop family: thesis wide, commerce portrait, SKU detail, and movement.
1440.density: 60/40 or ledger/grid rhythm with one authored interruption.
1440.interaction: Desktop enhancement may use one restrained showpiece; commerce controls remain DOM-first.
1440.fallback: Visible DOM facts and static poster remain available if enhanced media fails.
